podcast.body: This "seminal hip-hop smash" was a multi-platinum album and strong competition for Album of the Year at the 1997 Grammys. It was noted for sounding more like the mid-90s than Celine Dion's "Falling Into You," which won the award. "the Fuji's seminal hip-hop smash The Score."
